result.instructions: Tools for AlexisHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on leave this week, and what type of leave is it?"; "Show the vacation balance of everyone in the Sales department."; "List the employees in the Berlin office who were hired this year.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AlexisHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run alexishr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run alexishr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run alexishr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. alexishr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: alexishr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with work-related fields: name, work email, employee number, department, office, manager, hire and end dates. Personal fields are not returned. API: GET /v1/employee.

active.description: Only active (true) or only inactive (false) employees.

manager_employee_id.description: Filter by the manager's employee id.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (API default if omitted).

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

tools.name: alexishr_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id with work-related fields only (no SSN, bank account, address or private contact). API: GET /v1/employee/{id}.

employee_id.description: The record id (from the matching list tool).
